about: Audio check on rendered band audio (pitched accompaniment only, FluidSynth, settings of build.py; ii and V voiced as proposed in kod/bant.py). rub = band power in the two semitone bands (+-50 cents) next to the sung note, same octave; support = band power in the band of the sung note and of the octave below; whole_tone_neighbours = band power two semitones above and below the sung note. All in dB relative to one chord note of a strum (peak of the E4 band in the first off-beat strum of the answer bar before the verse, the same I chord in every plan). Shares are fractions of the sung time of the stretch; runs follow the 150 ms rule of olcum.json. The semitone bands also catch overtones of consonant band notes and the attack noise of every strum: only large differences and the runs above -6 dB are meaningful.
pitch_mode: note (a frame carries the pitch of the note it belongs to); the frame_pitch_* fields use every frame's own rounded pitch instead (for the rub this counts every glide into a unison with the band as a rub, so frame_pitch_rub is an upper bound)

SECILEN_kok_bas.what: chosen + bass on the root on beat 2 of bars 2 and 6

SECILEN_acik3.what: chosen + on-beat strum of beat 3 without the third in bars 0 and 5

IKINCI_kok_bas.what: runner-up + bass on the root on beat 2 of bars 2 and 6

varyant_ii-ii-V-I.what: chosen with ii ii V I in bar 0

V7_son_vurus_V-V-V-V7.what: chosen with V7 on the last beat of bars 2 and 6

V7_tum_olcu.what: chosen with V7 in all of bars 2 and 6

tasarimci_A_I-IV-I-I_V-V-V-V.what: designer A's plan as the band plays it

olcu5_V-V.what: chosen with V V on beats 2-3 of bar 5

options.open3_bars: verse bars in which the on-beat strum of beat 3 leaves out the third of the chord (accordion + banjo strike root and fifth, the banjo roll note is the fifth); the off-beat strum half a beat later is the full chord
options.root_bass_bars: verse bars in which the bass stays on the root on beat 2 (the builder plays the fifth there when beats 0-2 share a chord)

stretches.bar_0_beat_3: L1 from beat 2.95 ('-ligi var': G F E)
stretches.bars_2_6_beat_2: beat position 1.9 .. 2.95 of bars 2 and 6 (F on the beat, E on the off-beat)
stretches.bar_5_beat_3: bar 5 from beat 2.95 ('-gi-rir': G F E)

not_verified_by_ear: This is a measurement of spectral energy next to / on the sung pitch; nobody listened.
